transformations.description: Copies all fifteen Line 14 sections and all four Line 24 sections independently. Exact duplicate Line 14 source topologies remain distinct patterns because they are distinct published source occurrences.
The raw official Line 25 sequence contains 17 occurrences with stop 5311 repeated terminally; the canonical pattern stores 16 occurrences and closesLoop=true creates 7413→5311 exactly once.
Copies 48 accepted Cartagena StopNode/StopPlace identities exactly from prior accepted scenarios.
Uses official operator-linked map/directions coordinates for 76 newly created identities; these are Grade C, not surveyed platform geometry.
Assigns new stop identities to Cartagena, Fuente Álamo de Murcia, Murcia (Lobosillo), or Torre-Pacheco according to municipal-place evidence and the official stop coordinates.

warnings: The project label legacy is a scenario-family label; this package models the current published snapshot captured on 2026-08-13.
Line 14 is highly variant-heavy; no maximal-route flattening or missing reverse working is invented.
Line 14 source sections 2 and 15 have the same ordered stop-code topology but remain distinct source-supported patterns.
Line 24 crosses the Cartagena/Torre-Pacheco municipal boundary. Line 14 crosses Cartagena/Fuente Álamo de Murcia/Murcia municipal boundaries.
StopNode.sourceReferences are empty for all new identities because no genuine OpenStreetMap node/way was reconciled.
Later Cartagena components and merges must reuse every accepted shared StopNode/StopPlace and settlement canonical field exactly.
